scope: CPU-free event isolation with unknown DAC states mapped to zero; no full-board or clock qualification
interpretation: Captured release events reproduce the startup abort with every observed DAC control at zero volts. Omitting the release completes 150 us. A separate, electrically isolated PWL breakpoint at the release time also completes. Thus the release event matters, but an arbitrary analog breakpoint alone does not reproduce this failure; DAC/event scheduling remains to be isolated.
